name: meltingspot
description: Connects your assistant to the MeltingSpot MCP server and teaches it how to use its tools: one Spot per connection, pagination, batches, confirmations, errors and untrusted member content.

interface.longDescription: Connects to the MeltingSpot MCP server to read and manage the Spot of the connection: members, groups, tags, channels, lives, collections, moderation and search. Bundled skills teach the assistant the rules of the tools: confirmations, batches, pagination, errors and untrusted member content.
defaultPrompt: Show me the Spot of this connection
